**Analysis summary:**
- Test image: ripe orange-red tomato fruit with multiple dark, circular sunken lesions, concentric ring patterns, and dark/grayish-black fungal sporulation masses (acervuli)
- Anthracnose (Colletotrichum spp.) is the classic cause of circular, sunken, dark lesions with concentric rings and dark spore masses on ripe tomato fruit
- The Bugwood image number in the test (5475189) is nearly identical to the Anthracnose reference Bugwood_4.jpg (5475194) — same source series
- Alternaria references were microscopic, not showing matching macroscopic fruit symptoms
- The lesion morphology (circular, sunken, concentric rings, dark acervuli) is hallmark Anthracnose on tomato
